CheckVerification.description_en: Calls the CheckVerification operation to verify a verification code
CheckVerification.description_zh: 调用CheckVerification接口完成验证码校验

SearchVerification.description_en: Queries the details of verification results

StartVerification.description_en: Sends a verification code to an end user through a specified channel. Supported channels include SMS, voice, and WhatsApp
StartVerification.description_zh: 通过指定的通道向最终用户发送验证码，支持的通道有短信、语音、和whatsapp
